verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an OAuth client-credentials grant or a way to register machine clients that authenticate without a human. Several nearby features don't qualify. The API Key plugin is a different credential mechanism. The MCP plugin's OAuth authorization server role and the homepage's 'token exchange, and agent delegation' never mention client credentials. The Device Authorization flow explicitly requires a human approval step. These are adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue machine-to-machine credentials (client-credentials flow) so backend services and agents authenticate without a human in the loop
